verdict.rationale: Bevy has no editor, but the evidence mentions a first-party Bevy Remote Protocol that community agent tooling (bevy_brp) builds on, and a code-first cargo workflow an agent can drive. The protocol's capabilities, such as creating entities or scenes and editing components, are not documented in the pack. Builds run through cargo, the Rust host toolchain, rather than a Bevy interface. Missing for 10: documented details of the Remote Protocol's create/edit operations, a scriptable editor, a first-party build-trigger interface, an official MCP or agent integration, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can drive the editor and project programmatically — create scenes and nodes, edit properties, trigger builds — through a documented scriptable interface
